name: The Hook
text: Wait—before you buy another laptop, look at this ThinkPad!

name: Show the Build
text: This is the Lenovo ThinkPad T490s — clean, professional, and built for people who actually need their laptop to WORK.

name: Spec Attack
text: You’re getting an Intel Core i7 processor, 4 cores and 8 logical processors, 16GB RAM and a 256GB SSD.

name: Touchscreen & Everyday Work
text: That means smooth everyday multitasking for business, school, browsing, office work, content work and more.

name: Reliability & Reputation
text: And if you know ThinkPad, you already know the name is associated with a serious work machine — practical, professional and made for getting things done.

name: Windows 11 & Value Recap
text: Windows 11, 16 gigs of RAM, SSD storage — this is the kind of laptop you buy because you want to get work done, not because you want decoration on your table.
